## What's new in Kraki 0.2.79
- **Voice cut off mid-message:** if your connection stalls while you dictate, the words heard so far go back into the message box with a short note saying what happened. They no longer show up as a half message that failed to send. - **Messages stay in order:** a message that failed to send stays where you wrote it, and messages sent after it appear below it.

## What's new in Kraki 0.2.78
- **Updating from your phone** no longer stops on "Quit Kraki and take this Mac offline?" on this Mac, and always installs the newest version. - **Sessions waiting for your answer** no longer hold back an update: answer them afterwards and they carry on.

## What's new in Kraki 0.2.77
- **Custom Words sync right away.** Words you add or remove on your phone or in the browser show up on this Mac immediately, and removed words no longer come back. - **Sign Out works.** Kraki stays signed out until you sign in again; this Mac keeps serving its agents meanwhile. - **After a restart** the menu bar shows whether this Mac is online, even before you open the window. - **Updating** no longer asks whether to take this Mac offline. - **Devices:** remove an old device in Settings › Devices, and see when an offline one was last online. - **Offline computers:** the message box stays and your message is delivered when the computer is back. - **Steps** show each permission once, with what happened: Approved, or Denied with your reason. - **Sessions:** Rename… and Archive in the session menu; forks are named "Fork of …"; one name for each model everywhere. - Settings follow Light/Dark, and say plainly when notifications are off or voice isn't available.
